title: 받침 많은 단어 읽기 도전: 감사합니다는 어떻게 읽어요?
objective: By the end, you can read long everyday words with batchim block by block and use three sound rules: linking, ㄱ/ㅂ before ㄴ/ㅁ, and the basic final sounds.
summary: Practise reading long Korean words with many final consonants (batchim) at natural speed and with the right sound.

task.title: Read and write the sound
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then write its real sound in [ ] or answer the question.

words.meaning: teacher (also used to address a teacher)

words.exampleMeaning: We play soccer on the sports field.

letters.as: Read block by block, one even beat each: un-dong-jang.
The final consonant moves into the next empty ㅇ slot, keeping its sound.
Before ㄴ or ㅁ, ㄱ sounds like ng and ㅂ like m.
At a word's end, these finals sound like k, p, or t.

exercises: Linking: write the real sound in [ ]: ① 음악 ② 단어 ③ 일요일
ㄱ or ㅂ before ㄴ or ㅁ: write the real sound in [ ]: ① 국민 ② 입니다 ③ 작년
Final sounds: write how each word ends in [ ]: ① 부엌 ② 앞 ③ 낮
Does the 받침 move to the next block? Write Yes or No: ① 직업 ② 연필 ③ 발음
Read the whole phrase and write its real sound in [ ]: ① 밥을 먹어요 ② 회사원입니다 ③ 옷이 작아요
answers: ① Yes [지겁] ② No [연필] ③ Yes [바름]
